title: Brown Butter Coconut Lime Macaroon Cookies
story: This one has more steps than you'd expect from a cookie, and somehow every single one of them matters. Toast the coconut, brown the butter, rub the lime zest into the sugar with your fingers until it smells like you made the right choice. Then refrigerate the dough overnight because the coconut flour needs time. You can try to rush it, but the cookie will know.
totalTime: 4 hours 45 minutes minimum, ideally overnight (includes 4-hour chill)

items.text: ½ cup (45g) unsweetened large-flake coconut, toasted

steps.text: Spread 2½ cups (215g) shredded coconut and ½ cup (45g) large-flake coconut on a baking sheet. Toast at 325°F for 8–10 minutes, stirring once halfway through.
steps.donenessCue: Golden brown and fragrant. The flakes will color more than the shredded coconut — that's expected.

steps.text: Set aside to cool completely before using.
Cook ¾ cup (170g) unsalted butter in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
steps.donenessCue: Milk solids turn amber and it smells nutty.

steps.text: Remove from heat and let cool until warm but not hot before continuing.

In a large bowl, rub the zest of 3 limes into 1 cup (220g) dark brown sugar and ¼ cup (50g) granulated sugar with your fingers until the mixture is fragrant and slightly damp. This releases the lime oils directly into the sugar — the lime flavor infuses the whole dough rather than sitting on the surface.
Whisk the cooled brown butter into the lime sugar until smooth.
Add 2 large eggs, 1 large egg yolk, 2 tsp vanilla extract, and ½ tsp coconut extract (if using). Mix until glossy.
Add ¾ cup (95g) all-purpose flour, ¼ cup (30g) coconut flour, ½ tsp baking powder, and ¾ tsp kosher salt. Mix until just combined.
Fold in the cooled toasted shredded coconut and toasted coconut flakes.
steps.donenessCue: Dough will be thick and slightly sticky — that's correct, don't try to loosen it.

steps.text: Cover and refrigerate the dough for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight. The coconut flour needs time to hydrate — don't skip or shortcut this step.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Scoop 55–60g portions onto a lined baking sheet.

steps.donenessCue: Golden around the edges, slightly puffed, and soft in the middle. The centers will NOT look fully done — that's correct. Do not over-bake waiting for them to firm up.

steps.text: Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes. Finish with flaky sea salt while still warm.

ifYouFeelLikeIt: Lime curd center: press a thumbprint into each dough ball, add ½ tsp lime curd, then cover with a little more dough before baking.
White chocolate coconut shell: dip the cooled cookie bottoms in tempered white chocolate and sprinkle with toasted coconut.
Coconut caramel: fold ½ cup chopped soft caramel pieces into the dough — they melt into chewy pockets as it bakes.
storage: Baked cookies keep in an airtight container at room temperature for 4–5 days. Unbaked dough can be refrigerated up to 2 days or frozen (portioned into balls) for up to 2 months — bake from frozen, adding 1–2 extra minutes.
